answer: Sponsorship carries liability: each vouch locks 45 POA behind the newcomer, and the voucher above loses half again if the chain is convicted. Sponsors are capped at 6 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army. The sonnet of the cap is the choke point, the pulse of the bond is the deterrent, and the signal of the public chain is the evidence. A farm of 855 aliases must recruit 855 separate sponsors willing to stake real funds on strangers.
